units.source_text: 但是，此时此刻，比起听他这种充满血腥味儿的独自论断（当然也有其本身的魅力）来，

en.t: But at this very moment, rather than listen to his solitary judgments, so steeped in the smell of blood, though of course they had their own charm,

units.source_text: 我更想听他讲述他自己失去重贞以后的经历。

en.t: I wanted even more to hear him tell me about what he himself had experienced after losing Shigesada.

units.source_text: 如前所述，我一味从他那里期待着"人生"。

en.t: As I have said before, I was single-mindedly expecting life from him.

units.source_text: 我插话提出了这样暗示性的问题。

en.t: I broke in and posed this suggestive question.
